reason: The repository currently has ERA5 raw and processed artifacts, but no MERRA-2 or JRA-55 data products or adapter code. Implementing external validation would require data acquisition, variable harmonization, unit/calendar checks, and a panel adapter before any causal estimate would be comparable.

MERRA-2.main_bottleneck: NASA Earthdata access and mapping MERRA-2 precipitation, SST/skin temperature or ocean surface fields, and 500 hPa geopotential/height into the existing monthly panel schema.

JRA-55.main_bottleneck: JRA-55 access and variable/calendar/unit harmonization, especially ensuring monthly precipitation and z500 semantics match the ERA5 panel abstraction.

claim_policy: Do not claim external replication in the CCAI or course deliverables until an adapter writes an external_validation_<dataset>.json artifact with the headline PNW estimate.
